caseName: Chevron U.S.A. Inc. v. Natural Resources Defense Council, Inc.
caseNameFull: Chevron U.S.A. Inc. v. Natural Resources Defense Council, Inc. American Iron & Steel Institute v. Natural Resources Defense Council, Inc. and Ruckelshaus, Administrator, Environmental Protection Agency v. Natural Resources Defense Council, Inc.

opinions.text: C. A. D. C. Cir. Motion of Mid-America Legal Foundation for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Certiorari granted, cases consolidated, and a total of one hour allotted for oral argument. Reported below: 222 U. S. App. D. C. 268, 685 F. 2d 718.
